verdicts.A4_expansion_failed_bottleneck_is_PC: PARTIAL(PC-gate is the largest filter among live-baseline cells but reproducibility and dead baselines also remove cells; attribution to PC alone not fully substantiated)

reviewer_B.scope: T2 7-class decomposition / official scorer components / null-vs-artifact

verdicts.B2_agent_did_not_execute_mutation_is_rea: PARTIAL(plausibly real but lacks direct per-run confirmation of agent termination)

agreement: Reviewers cover disjoint rubrics; NO PASS-vs-FAIL conflict on any shared item. Both accept the honest headline (expansion did not meet the min-gate; T2 dominated by non-execution of mutation) but each flags an over-claim.
actions_taken_in_main_report: A4: bottleneck attribution rewritten with the explicit 3-way tally (5 eligible / 7 lost to PC-gate only / 3 lost to reproducibility / 7 never produced a live baseline).

B3: the COMMUNICATE-failure zero-classes are DOWNGRADED from 'real null' to 'real-but-underpowered null' (only 3/67 runs reached a correct-DB mutation where COMMUNICATE could fail); the report does NOT claim COMMUNICATE is never the bottleneck.

B2: 'agent_did_not_execute_mutation' is defined operationally (junction found, 0 suffix mutations, agent did not keep asking) and the report notes per-run trajectory confirmation is not yet human-verified.
note: Both reviewers produced full verdicts against different local endpoints in separate processes; the two PARTIAL/FAIL items are accepted and reflected as limitations rather than overturned.
